tiers.description: Tier 1 Medically Indigent: 95% discount if balance due is 5% or more of annual income; patient not billed more than AGB.
Tier 2 Medically Indigent: income above 500% FPL and balance due 20% or more of annual income; 80% discount.
Tier 3 Catastrophic: income above 250% FPL and balance due exceeds 100% of annual income; 98% discount.

evidence.quote: These Medically Indigent patients are eligible for a 95% discount as set forth in Attachment B.

asset_test.details: Assets are considered: cash, stocks, bonds and other financial assets that can be liquidated within 7 days; non-liquid assets generally not considered. Savings accounts, trust funds and life insurance may also be considered.

evidence.quote: For purposes of this policy, assets shall include cash, stocks, bonds and other financial assets that can be liquidated within 7 days.
Patients are given the opportunity to apply for financial assistance up to 365 days from the date of service.

presumptive_eligibility: Texas Health may screen uninsured patients using third-party data, and Medicaid, Project Access or Healing Hands patients are presumed eligible; uninsured patients with balance of $40,000 or more and vendor-estimated FPL over 250% may get an automatic 75% discount.
how_to_apply: MyChart portal at www.texashealth.org/Costs-and-Billing/Financial-Assistance; paper application at www.TexasHealth.org/Financial-Assistance; CustomerService@TexasHealth.org; 1.800.890.6034; mail to 612 E. Lamar Blvd. 10th Floor, Arlington, TX 76011, Attention Financial Assistance Team; or in person at admissions offices.
warnings: Discount tiers above 250% FPL depend on the balance due as a percentage of annual income (5%, 20%, or 100%); they are not purely income-based.
Tier 3 Catastrophic (98%) overlaps with Tier 1 and Tier 2 income ranges; section A-5.0 says 251% or greater while Attachment B says exceeds 250%.
Presumptive 75% discount (balance $40,000+, vendor FPL > 250%) and A-6.0 minimum patient responsibility of 25% also exist.
No upper FPL limit is given for discounts (Tier 2 applies above 500% FPL), so discount.fpl_max_percent is null.

Free care at 250% FPL is described as a discount equal to the balance less the amount deemed able to pay, and the patient must lack sufficient funds and assets; the 100% discount appears in the Attachment B table.
Policy section 4.2 also mentions facilities managed by the Texas Health Business Office; some covered entities are not managed by it (Attachment C).
Appeals are allowed during the first 365 days from the initial billing date.
The 90-day classification period applies to medically indigent classification.
Attachment B dollar table is based on Jan 2026 guidelines; the % of FPL is also stated.
Page 16 table has a minor inconsistency in dollar boundaries for Tier 2 ('Over $79,801' vs Tier 1 up to $79,800).
